subject: Demo: Dedicated capacity for Acme Logistics — throughput & latency requirements
messages:
From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme-logistics.com>
To: sales@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Interested in Dedicated capacity for real-time inference

Hi Redwood team,

We just signed up and ran a few self-serve tests. We're evaluating Dedicated capacity for a production deployment. Quick context: we need sustained ~250 QPS for short sequences (~128 tokens) with a 95th percentile latency target of <120ms (end-to-end). We also have burst peaks up to 800 QPS for brief periods.

Can we set up a demo that covers: throughput and latency behavior, autoscaling for Dedicated pools, quantization/accuracy tradeoffs, and routing/fallback options? Happy to share a short doc with our QPS profile (attached).

Best,
Sam Turner
Engineering Lead, Real-time Systems
Acme Logistics
Attachment: acme_qps_requirements.pdf
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme-logistics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Dedicated capacity for real-time inference

Hi Sam — thanks for the note and for signing up! Really appreciate the context and the QPS doc.

Marissa (AE) and Laura (Solutions Eng) are looped in. Quick / proposed next steps:
- 30–45 minute demo to cover Dedicated capacity architecture, autoscaling behavior, and perf expectations
- Please pick one of these times (PST):
  • Mon 11/23, 10:00–10:45am
  • Tue 11/24, 1:00–1:45pm
  • Wed 11/25, 11:00–11:45am

I'll include a one-pager on Dedicated to give baseline numbers ahead of the call (attached). Please let us know which works and share any additional folks to include.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
SDR, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_dedicated_onepager.pdf

Thanks — Tue 11/24 1:00pm PST works for us. Please include Lee (cc'ed) from infra and any SE/product folks who can speak to autoscaling behavior and KV/prefix caching.

A couple quick questions to prep the demo: 
- For Dedicated pools, how is autoscaling triggered (queue-based, latency SLO, headroom)?
- Do you support prefix/KV caching across requests to reduce per-token compute?

Looking forward to the demo — please send calendar invite.

Sam Turner

Acme Logistics

Hi Sam / Lee — great — confirmed Tue 11/24, 1:00–1:45pm PST. Invite is on the way.

Laura and Dylan, thanks for joining — Dylan will cover Dedicated autoscaling and kernel/quantization tradeoffs; Laura will jump into architecture and KV/prefix caching behavior. A few notes for the demo agenda:
1) Quick intro (5 min)
2) Deployment options + Dedicated pool architecture (10 min) — Laura
3) Throughput & latency: live perf slides + perf envelope for 128-token sequences (10 min) — Marissa/Dylan
4) Autoscaling & routing policies (10 min) — Dylan
5) Q&A & next steps (10 min)

Sam — we'll review your attached QPS doc during the call; if you have an internal SLO doc or traffic window examples please drop them here beforehand.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—
